development: Wanhua has shut its 800 kt Fujian MDI plant for about 20 days of regular maintenance
context: The average operating rate of Chinese MDI production fell ten points to 66% that week. The plant is still 800,000 t/yr, so the approved expansion has not started.
internal_note: Isocyanate market letter, issue of 1 July 2026 - the date here is that issue; the shutdown it reports began 23 June 2026

development: Covestro announces a 660 kt MDI unit for Shanghai, start-up around 2030
context: About an eighth of today's Chinese MDI capacity, from a producer that already holds 600 kt there. Energy-efficient technology aimed at net-zero emissions, with a similar project under evaluation in the UAE.
internal_note: Covestro announcement, 30 June 2026 - announcement and event are the same day

development: BASF is reported to be expanding Geismar, US, to about 600 kt, targeted for the third quarter of 2026
context: About USD 1bn, roughly doubling the site. US buyers facing anti-dumping duties on Chinese material are the reason it is being built, so it is a call on Chinese export volume rather than Chinese capacity.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - Table 23 gives the timing as targeted Q3 2026

development: US preliminary anti-dumping duties of 376-512% on Chinese MDI imports are reported in force since September 2025
context: Issued by the US Department of Commerce. At that level the US market is effectively closed to Chinese MDI, pushing volume into Asia and Europe and reinforcing the case for building capacity in the US.
internal_note: EUROPUR FY2025 report, published August 2026 - the duties were issued September 2025

development: BASF Chongqing MDI is reported to have reached operation by the end of 2024
context: 400 kt, the only non-Chinese-owned MDI plant added inland. Western majors are still investing in China even as the balance of new capacity tilts towards domestic producers.
internal_note: US anti-dumping review of Chinese MDI, read August 2026 - operational by end 2024

development: Huntsman announced an increase of EUR 250/t on MDI in Europe, Africa and the Middle East
context: Effective 1 August, subject to contract. European producers raising while US anti-dumping duties keep Chinese MDI out of America pushes that volume towards Europe.
internal_note: Identified in Charlie's European price research of 16 September 2026

development: Dow announced an increase of EUR 200/t on MDI and MDI-based products in Europe
context: The second European MDI letter in a month, after Huntsman's on 1 August. Two majors moving the same way is a producer-side move rather than one company's position.
internal_note: Reported 26-27 August 2026, immediate effect. Identified in Charlie's European price research of 16 September 2026
